title: Ingest API skeleton: health, readiness & graceful shutdown

user_story.i_want: the ingest API to start, expose health and readiness endpoints, and shut down gracefully
user_story.so_that: it can be run and probed like any production service

description: An Axum app on a configurable address (default 0.0.0.0:8080). `GET /healthz` is liveness (always 200) and `GET /readyz` is readiness (it checks Firehose from STR-206 onward). An `AppState` is shared through `Arc`. tower-http layers add tracing, a request body limit (default 4 MiB), a timeout and request IDs. Graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM.

acceptance_criteria.given: a slow request is in flight
acceptance_criteria.then: the request completes, then the process exits 0 and logs 'shutdown complete'

acceptance_criteria.given: a body larger than the limit

acceptance_criteria.then: the log line has method, path, status, latency and request id; the response has an x-request-id header

acceptance_criteria.when: it is built by a function returning Router
acceptance_criteria.then: a test calls it in-process with `oneshot` without binding a port

rust_concepts: Arc<T> and Clone for shared state
